def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import glob
    import pandas as pd

    pattern = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/State MSA Fraud and Other data/*.csv"
    paths = sorted(glob.glob(pattern))
    if not paths:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No files matched pattern: {pattern}")

    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df["__source_file"] = p.split("/")[-1]
        dfs.append(df)

    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return out

def process(loadFraudMsaFiles) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = loadFraudMsaFiles.copy()
    # Standardize column names
    metro_col = [c for c in df.columns if "Metropolitan" in c][0]
    reports_col = "Unnamed: 1"  # holds '# of Reports'

    out = df[[metro_col, reports_col, "__source_file"]].rename(
        columns={metro_col: "metroArea", reports_col: "fraudReports"}
    )

    # Drop header/footer/blank rows
    out["metroArea"] = out["metroArea"].astype("string")
    out["fraudReports"] = out["fraudReports"].astype("string")

    out = out[
        out["metroArea"].notna()
        & ~out["metroArea"].str.contains("^Metropolitan Area$", case=False, na=False)
        & ~out["metroArea"].str.contains("^Source:", case=False, na=False)
    ].copy()

    # Parse numeric counts with thousands separators
    out["fraudReports"] = (
        out["fraudReports"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
    )
    out["fraudReports"] = pd.to_numeric(out["fraudReports"], errors="coerce")

    out = out.dropna(subset=["fraudReports"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    out["state"] = out["__source_file"].str.replace(".csv", "", regex=False)

    return out[["state", "metroArea", "fraudReports"]]

def process(cleanFraudMsa, cleanIdTheftMsa) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    merged = cleanIdTheftMsa.merge(
        cleanFraudMsa,
        on=["state", "metroArea"],
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    exceeded = merged[merged["idTheftReports"] > merged["fraudReports"]].copy()
    exists = len(exceeded) > 0

    return pd.DataFrame([{"existsMetroAreaIdTheftExceedsFraud": exists}])
